doc_friction.issue: Says to use run_in_background for long jobs but not that LightGBM processes must not run in parallel on the 4-core cloud box (num_threads=4 each); the OMP_NUM_THREADS note covers GP/BLAS only. Cost 18 minutes.
Recomputes every requested cell even when the results file already has it, so resuming after a timeout needs hand-picked --held/--test-years/--variants.

Session 87's rounds --score run took 9 minutes for 12 cells; the ipcw variants on SF+Austin sources take 5 to 10 minutes per cell (300-round fits on 2.4M rows), so the session-87-based time estimate was 3x short.

certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
